subject: MAP checkpoint: Marketplace purchase & reseller steps for Beacon Systems
messages:
From: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@beaconsys.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Rhodes <sam@cloudresell.com>, procurement@beaconsys.com
Date: 2027-05-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff + marketplace path (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Beacon's product team is excited about the latency profile and the private deployment options. Procurement asked me to put together a short MAP so we can align timelines for: marketplace listing (AWS + Azure), reseller invoicing (CloudResell), and any legal/DS review required for purchase.

I attached a short requirements pack (Beacon-MAP-Requirements.pdf) with target procurement dates. High level asks:
- Confirm which marketplace flows you support (AWS SaaS Contract, Azure Marketplace, GCP Marketplace) and typical lead times.
- Outline steps for reseller invoicing and when Beacon needs to accept terms.
- Identify the owner on Redwood side for security attestation and a single point for procurement contacts.

Can we do a 30-min MAP checkpoint today or tomorrow to lock owners and dates? Sam from CloudResell will join to confirm invoicing cadence.

Thanks,
Emma Taylor
Head of Platform Partnerships
Beacon Systems
emma.taylor@beaconsys.com | +1 415-555-0192

[attachment: Beacon-MAP-Requirements.pdf]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@beaconsys.com>
Cc: Sam Rhodes <sam@cloudresell.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + marketplace path (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Emma — great to hear, thanks for the packet. I can run today's checkpoint at 3pm PT if that works for you and Sam; otherwise tomorrow morning works. I've looped Marcus (billing & marketplace) and Sergio (partner ops) so we have the right owners on the call.

Quick answers inline to get us started:
- Redwood supports listing on AWS Marketplace (SaaS Contract), Azure Marketplace (publish + third-party reseller), and GCP Marketplace (SaaS/Private offer). Typical listing time: 2-4 weeks for basic listing + 1-2 weeks for procurement paperwork.
- Reseller invoicing with CloudResell: we typically set up a reseller SOW + pass-through invoicing. Marcus will confirm exact steps and whether Beacon needs to sign any additional reseller docs.
- Security attestation/attestations: Sergio will own the SOC2 evidence package and can provide a targeted bundle for procurement.

Proposed immediate agenda for today's 30-min checkpoint:
1) Confirm marketplace target(s) (AWS/Azure/GCP) and primary purchase path
2) Reseller invoicing model and required docs from Beacon
3) Legal/DS items that block procurement sign-off
4) Owners, deadlines, and next sync date

If that looks good I will send calendar invite.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai | +1 206-555-0138

[calendars: Evelyn’s 3pm slot suggested]

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + marketplace path (AWS/Azure/GCP) — invoicing & listing checklist

Adding detail from billing/marketplace side so we have concrete actions:

Action items (Marcus):
- Create marketplace checklist for Beacon with required artifacts for AWS/Azure/GCP listings (due: 2027-05-05) — attachment: aws-marketplace-checklist.pdf
- Confirm reseller invoice flow with CloudResell and produce standard reseller SOW template (due: 2027-05-06)

Requested from Beacon (Emma / procurement):
- Provide Beacon legal & billing contact + tax forms so CloudResell can scope invoicing cadence (owner: Beacon procurement; due: 2027-05-04)
- Confirm which marketplace(s) Beacon wants to purchase through first (owner: Emma; due: 2027-05-03)

Notes:
- If Beacon prefers AWS Marketplace private offers, we need their AWS account ID and the single email that will receive the seller offer — that shortens the process to ~7-10 business days. Public listing will take longer due to listing review cycles.
- For Azure, partner registration and publisher validation can add up to 2 weeks; we can run the listing in parallel with contract signatures.

I'll attach the checklist in the invite.

Thanks everyone — 3pm PT worked well. Summary from Beacon side and one small update:

Decisions agreed on call:
- Primary purchase path: AWS Marketplace (private offer) first, then Azure Marketplace listing in parallel.
- Reseller: CloudResell will handle billing passthrough; Beacon will sign reseller SOW once Redwood and CloudResell share templates.
- Legal gating items: Beacon legal accepts Redwood's standard data residency clause with one edit (narrow the retention window). Beacon legal will send the redline to Sergio by 2027-05-04.

Beacon action items (Emma / procurement):
- Send AWS account ID and billing contact (owner: procurement@beaconsys.com; due: 2027-05-03)
- Review MAP spreadsheet and confirm dates (owner: Emma; due: 2027-05-04)

Redwood action items:
- Marcus: Share marketplace checklist & reseller SOW template (due: 2027-05-05)
- Sergio: Share standard legal clause + await Beacon redline (due: 2027-05-04)
- Evelyn: Schedule follow-up MAP checkpoint next week and share updated MAP spreadsheet (MAP_v1.xlsx attached).

I've attached an updated MAP spreadsheet (MAP_v1.xlsx) with the owners and dates captured. Please confirm or suggest edits.
